What is this app?

이 앱은

Who it is for

KOR4ET is a Korean-learning app for international students in the English track at Jeonju University 영어 트랙 유학생을 위한 한국어 앱. Explanations are in English, with Korean beside them.

How you learn

The content is divided into small lessons by topic. Each lesson has words, example sentences, short conversations and review questions. Listen, look at the word cards, then test yourself.

Use it anywhere

It works on both phones and computers. Save the audio on your device and you can listen without the internet.

Menu overview

메뉴 구성
기초회화Everyday conversations: greetings, shopping, asking the way …
문자학습The Hangeul alphabet and pronunciation.
문장규칙Grammar: endings and sentence patterns.
짝말비교Word pairs compared (opposites or similar sounds).
비슷한말Words with similar meanings and how they differ.
단어가족Words that come from the same root.
대학생활 · 아르바이트Korean for university life and part-time jobs.
듣기연습Listen to stories, conversations, announcements and news in Korean.
TOPIKThe Korean language test and practice questions.
대한민국Get to know Korea: history, food, places to visit (reading only).
도움말This page: introduction and how to use the app.

Voices and readings

소리와 독음
Korean voiceKorean AI voice (female). In TOPIK listening questions, the man's lines use a male voice.
English voiceThe English meaning is read by an English AI voice (female). You can turn it off with English voice (K).
ReadingThe green romanization shows how the word is actually pronounced, not how it is spelled. Examples: 독립 dongnip, 한라산 hallasan.
NoteRomanization is not 100% the same as the Korean sound. Listen to the real voice and repeat.

Getting started

처음 시작하기

What is this app?

The app teaches Korean in lessons 묶음 by topic. Each lesson has words, example sentences, short conversations and review questions.

① Main areasThe top row of the menu: 기초회화 · 문자학습 · 문장규칙 · 짝말비교 · 비슷한말 · 단어가족 · 대학생활 · 아르바이트 · 듣기연습 · TOPIK · 대한민국 · 도움말
② Sub-groupsThe round buttons in the lower row (01, 02 …). Scroll sideways to see more.
③ LessonsTap the lesson title box at the top of the content area to see the list of lessons in that sub-group.
Previous · NextThe ← 이전 묶음 · 다음 묶음 → buttons at the very bottom
Swipe (phone)Swipe left = next lesson, swipe right = previous lesson 왼쪽으로 밀면 다음 묶음, 오른쪽은 이전 묶음. Start the swipe a little away from the edge of the screen. Swiping on the menu, tables, pictures and the audio bar does not change the lesson.
SearchThe search box is at the top: you can type in Korean or English. Tap a result to go to that lesson.

My study 내 학습

Under the search box: 🔥 days in a row, how many lessons you have opened (%), today's lessons and quizzes, and the next new lesson. Opened lessons get a ✓ in the lesson list, and a thin line under each sub-group button shows how much of it you have seen.

Where to start

If you are new, read 문자학습 (the Hangeul alphabet) first, then start 기초회화 → 인사·소개.

Sentences · Words · Quiz

예문보기·단어공부·확인퀴즈
Sentences 문장Shows words, example sentences and conversations. Tap 🔊 to listen. ※ Under each sentence, the meanings of its words are shown. The green romanization is the reading.
Words 단어Word cards. Tap a card to listen, and flip it to see the meaning and an example.
Quiz 퀴즈Choose 1 of 4: choose the meaning, choose the Korean word, listen and choose, fill in the blank.

Review questions

At the bottom of the Sentences page there are questions. Tap Show answer to check, and tap again to hide it.

대한민국 · 도움말

Some areas are reading pages only: there is no audio and no play button.

How to play audio

재생 방법
🔊Plays that word or sentence again and again. Tap again to stop.
⑤ Play lesson 묶음 재생Plays every word and sentence in this lesson from start to end, then starts again.
④ Play all 연속 재생When this lesson ends, it goes on to the next lesson by itself. Good for listening while you travel.
Repeat this word · ConversationPlays only that word with its examples, or only the conversation.
① Times 횟수How many times each sentence is played (1–5). The same sentence repeats after a short pause.
② Speed 속도×0.7 (slow) to ×2.0 (fast), in steps of 0.1.
③ English voice ENOn: you hear the Korean, then the English meaning once. Off: you hear only the Korean.

Audio bar

While audio is playing, a bar appears at the bottom of the screen: you can pause or cancel. The line being played is highlighted. The page scrolls only when that line gets close to the top or bottom edge.

Keyboard shortcuts

키보드 단축키

Shortcuts are not used on phones: please tap the buttons on the screen. 폰에서는 화면의 버튼을 눌러 주세요.

For computers and tablets with a keyboard. They also work when your keyboard is set to English or Korean.

How to use Listening Practice

듣기연습 쓰는 법

Listen first

듣기연습 has campus announcements, stories, conversations, announcements and news. Each lesson starts with a text.

① Listen to it allTap Play lesson 묶음 재생: listen to the text from start to end. The text stays hidden until you tap Show text 본문 보기.
② Line by lineTap 🔊 on each line, or use ← → to listen again.
③ WordsThe Words tab 단어: the key words of the lesson as word cards.
④ QuestionsAt the bottom of the page: questions about the content (who, where, how much).

Voices

In conversations, the first person has a female voice and the second person has a male voice. Turn off English voice (K) to hear only Korean.

Saving audio and using offline

음성 저장과 오프라인
Save audio 음성 앱에 저장Tap ⤓ at the bottom of the page to save all the audio on your device. The first time takes a little while. After that, you can listen without the internet.
Add to Home ScreeniPhone: Safari → Share button → Add to Home Screen. Android: Chrome → Menu → Install app.
UpdatesClose the app completely and open it again to get the new version. The version number is at the bottom of the page.
Theme · Text size 화면 · 글자 크기At the bottom of the page: Auto / Light / Dark, and A− to A++ for bigger text.
Study recordYour last opened lesson and your settings are saved only on this device.
Usage statistics 사용 통계To improve the app, it sends anonymous counts: which lessons are opened, quiz scores, the date and time, and the device type (phone, tablet or computer). No name, e-mail or location is sent; your device only gets a random number. 이름·이메일·위치는 보내지 않고, 기기마다 무작위 번호만 씁니다.

No sound?

If a word has no audio file, the app uses your device's Korean voice. If your device doesn't have one, please install a Korean voice in Settings, or use Chrome / Edge.

Learning statistics

학습 통계

How KOR4ET is used: all learners together. KOR4ET를 쓰는 모든 학습자의 전체 합계입니다.
